## Introduction
`multifactor` and `linkmap` are a pair of S7 classes to organize and manage 
multiple sets of factors, for instance when tracing or converting feature IDs 
across databases. Methods for `multifactor` aim to follow `factor` behaviour.

## Installation instructions

Get the latest stable `R` release from [CRAN](http://cran.r-project.org/). Then
install the released version of `multifactor`:

```{r 'cran-install', eval = FALSE}
install.packages("multifactor")
```

Or install the development version from this repository:

```{r, 'remotes-install', eval = FALSE}
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Minotau-R/multifactor")
```
